stem: A social platform needs a database that can traverse friends-of-friends relationships for its recommendation feature, and separately needs a leaderboard that returns current top scores with sub-millisecond read latency. Which TWO services fit these two needs respectively? (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Amazon Neptune for the relationship traversal
Amazon Keyspaces for the relationship traversal
Amazon DocumentDB for the relationship traversal

rationale: Neptune stores nodes and edges and is built to traverse many-to-many relationships like a friends-of-friends graph, and ElastiCache delivers the sub-millisecond, in-memory reads a live leaderboard needs. Keyspaces is a wide-column, Cassandra-compatible database built for large numbers of variable columns per row, not relationship traversal. Redshift is built for analytical queries over large datasets, not sub-millisecond single-value lookups. DocumentDB stores and queries nested JSON-like documents, not graph relationships.
